title: PRNTS
tagline: Decentralization hub for artists where fans can invest and manage an artist's projectsUnfortunately a few members dropped out midway through the project.
description: Prnts is a social investment platform and music discovery tool where artists allow their fans to invest in individual projects in exchange for monthly revenue from the song or album's streams.  Fans have the ability to govern certain aspects of the project including budgets for music videos, advertisements, and collaborations. Fans will be able to follow specific projects and receive an airdrop token which will be automatically staked into a streaming pool which will pay out the monthly streaming revenue.
how_its_made: solidity, react js, IPFS, lens protocol. Sadly we were not able to complete the project in time for the hackathon, we still plan on using lens protocol for our project and would love to work with your team in the future.  We were able to create a subgraph and began to work on our Ui/ux. Unfortunately a few members dropped out midway through the project.
